topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: Rain never quits around here, and neither do some people’s secrets. Found out my neighbor, old Jimmy, has been living like he’s got two dimes to rub together. Turns out, the guy's loaded. Been flocking off on private trips, getting top-shelf stuff, all under the radar. You’d think he could’ve thrown a bone to the block. Instead, he’s been sitting on his cash like it’s the only friend he’s got. Well, I saw through him the moment it poured out. People like Jimmy, they think their dough puts them above the rest, like they bought themselves a get-out-of-jail-free card. I've seen this song and dance before, and it always ends the same. When the lies and the cash run thin, you’re left with nothing but the cold, hard truth and the rain that won't stop falling.
